DUNGEON RULES

CONTROLS
WASD — Move

OBJECTIVE
You auto-fire at the nearest enemy.
Clear all enemies to unlock doors.
Explore the dungeon floor by floor.
Reach the ☠ BOSS at the end of each floor.
Find 💰 SHOP rooms to spend coins.
ROOM TYPES
⚔ Combat — clear to proceed
☠ Elite — hard, great loot
💰 Shop — walk into the stall
❤ Rest — healing tree
📦 Treasure — chests & loot
☠ Boss — floor guardian
ROOT SHRINE
Death awards Soul Shards.
Spend them on permanent stats.
Harder descents earn more Shards.
The Shrine glows when power is waiting.
Boss cleared = next floor + shop.
